headline: US Mortgage Rates Surge Back Above 7.2% as Treasury Yields Rise
summary: Average US 30-year fixed mortgage rates increased to 7.28%, reversing a four-week decline as elevated Treasury yields elevated borrowing costs across the real estate sector.
why: Mortgage borrowing rates dictate housing market affordability, construction demand, and broader consumer balance sheet expenditures in the United States.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Higher home loan borrowing rates suppress home buyer purchasing capacity and housing transactions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
